taglines: Tuesday. That's it. That's the whole complaint. Tuesday.
You opened a tab to look something up. You now have 47 tabs open. The original tab is a myth. The original question is gone. You are the tabs.
Someone replied 'per my last email' in Slack. The office is quiet. A tumbleweed rolls past the Jira board. Nobody move.
It worked on your machine. Your machine is a golden god of chaos that exists outside the laws of this universe. Production is not your machine.
You said you'd refactor it 'next sprint.' That was Q3. The code has a birthday now. It has outlived three engineers and one CTO. The code endures.
The meeting could've been an email. The email could've been a Slack. The Slack could've been silence. You could've been home. You are not home.
Your AI assistant confidently gave you the wrong answer and apologized so sincerely you almost thanked it. You need to go outside.
Wednesday is close enough to Friday if you squint and do absolutely no math whatsoever. Stay strong.
